rows.claim: PE is an auditable primary signal and an effective learning source.
rows.retained_claim: PE is an auditable primary signal grounded to true LSS.
rows.rejected_claim: The tested PE-driven arm improves held-out behavior over PE-drive-off.
rows.key_result: seed 101 behavioral success was 1.0 vs 1.0; gain 0.0 < 0.25; remaining seeds stopped by preregistration.

rows.claim: Conditional z-space action value causally controls frozen residual behavior.
rows.retained_claim: The v35 train-fit selector beat its preregistered permutation null on train, fresh validation, and locked confirmation.
rows.rejected_claim: The v36 closed-loop shadow selector is ready for runtime SHADOW or live wiring.
rows.key_result: v35 deltas were +0.0020/+0.0146/+0.0061; v36 fresh validation selector-permutation was -0.040979.

rows.claim: Segment-aware active learning saves labels because it uses emergent temporal abstraction.
rows.retained_claim: Typed feedback request and OpenLoop actuation are runnable, auditable, boundary-safe, and rollback-capable.
rows.rejected_claim: Segment-aware or PE-driven selection saves labels on the locked corpus.
rows.key_result: All arms had balanced accuracy 0.5 and labels-needed 61; segment gains versus turn/random/shuffled were 0.

rows.claim: Multi-frequency nested CMS improves the absorption-retention Pareto over matched single-timescale memory.
rows.retained_claim: Multi-frequency CMS cadence, replay, rollback, and frozen-substrate boundaries are runnable and auditable.
rows.rejected_claim: The measured multi-frequency Pareto gain reaches the preregistered minimum effect.

rows.claim: Slow learned meta-init transfers knowledge and adapts faster than copy, random, and zero initialization.
rows.retained_claim: Nested initialization is owner-controlled, zero-leakage, auditable, and checkpoint rollback-capable.
rows.rejected_claim: Meta-init is faster than direct copy or contains a distinguishable user-related prior.
rows.key_result: Meta and copy both reached target at step 0; meta AUC was lower by 0.000171; paired/swapped AUC differed by about 1.18e-6.
